diagnosis: The Arweave transaction receipt lookup endpoint retrieves permanent data upload tags, checksums, and payer wallet information using txId directly from the route parameter. It does not verify that the authenticated caller submitted the transaction or belongs to the owning team, enabling competitors to inspect proprietary data upload metadata and wallet activity.
